scripts.slint-dev: cd backend && cross-env SLINT_EMIT_DEBUG_INFO=1 SLINT_MCP_PORT=9315 cargo run -p rai-pal-slint --features slint/mcp
scripts.slint-dev-live: cd backend && cross-env SLINT_LIVE_PREVIEW=1 SLINT_EMIT_DEBUG_INFO=1 SLINT_MCP_PORT=9315 cargo run -p rai-pal-slint --features slint/live-preview,slint/mcp
scripts.build-deploy-deck: npm run podman-build-linux; npm run deploy-deck
scripts.build-slint-windows: cd backend && cargo xwin build --release -p rai-pal-slint --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.podman-build-slint-appimage: podman run --rm --pull=newer -v ${PWD}:/app -w /app -e LINUXDEPLOY=/var/cache/tauri/linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage -e APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 ghcr.io/raicuparta/rai-pal-builder:linux-latest npm run build-slint-appimage
scripts.podman-build-slint-appimage-local: podman build -f Containerfile.linux -t rai-pal-builder:linux-local . && podman run --rm -v ${PWD}:/app -w /app -e LINUXDEPLOY=/var/cache/tauri/linuxdeploy-x86_64.AppImage -e APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 rai-pal-builder:linux-local npm run build-slint-appimage
scripts.cleanup: tsc && npm run lint && npm run format
scripts.find-unused: cd backend && del index.scip &&  cargo workspace-unused-pub
